title: Français 3575 — f56r
contents: The proposed surrender of the château of Clermont to the comte de Montgomery, the danger of alienating the religious party, and a recommendation for a judicial appointment.

excerpt: **…pas dans sa lettre et pretend ne povvoir obeir. Vovs scaves de qvelle importance est Clermont et ez [m]ains de qvi il entrera. C’est à vovs, Monsi…**
translation: …not in his letter, and claims that he cannot obey. You know how important Clermont is and into whose [hands] it will fall. It is for you, Sir…

excerpt: **[b]on essient. C’est à vovs à adviser sy vovs lvy vovlez procvrer ce bien car ie tiens qv’il en est digne et ce cera chose profitable av service dv roy, à vovs et à moy.**
translation: in [good] earnest. It is for you to decide whether you wish to obtain this favour for him, because I consider him worthy of it, and it would benefit the king’s service, you and me.
